headline: Build cards, link previews, and the classic calculator retired.
notes: Added Copy build card and Save card to Import / Export. The card is an image of the build for posting where links don't preview.
Links to the site now preview with a screenshot of the sheet. New app icon, and the installed app is now called Aether Codex.
The classic calculator is retired. Old /classic and /aether.html links open the sheet, and share links keep their build.
The light theme no longer flashes dark while the page loads.
RES and Dark text are easier to read on the dark theme.
Updates now download only what changed. The first update after this one downloads everything once.
